BETA Close X RS Group plc has purchased 271,798 of its ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme, with purchases occurring between August 10th and August 14th, 2026, at prices ranging from 720.50 pence to 743.00 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares stand at 469,913,116, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in a total of 469,913,116 voting rights. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 17 August 2026 RS Group plc 17 August 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 10 August 2026 to 14 August 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 469,913,116 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total number of voting rights in the Company is 469,913,116. This announcement is made in accordance with the requirements of UK Listing Rule 9.6.6.
